definitions.explanation: The act of going beneath the surface of water, whether by a person (diving) or a vessel (submerging). Used for both recreational diving and submarine operations.

examples.japanese: {潜水|せんすい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}した→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I dived underwater and observed the fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{潜水|せんすい}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{防水|ぼうすい}→防水：06428_bousui⟧だ。
examples.english: This watch is designed for diving and is waterproof to 100 meters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{潜水艦|せんすいかん}→潜水艦：15701_sensuikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{海底|かいてい}→海底：13287_kaitei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧{潜水|せんすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The submarine quietly began to submerge toward the ocean floor.

notes:
A compound of {潜|せん} (to dive, to lurk) and {水|すい} (water).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{潜水艦|せんすいかん}→潜水艦：15701_sensuikan⟧ (submarine)
- {潜水|せんすい}{士|し} (professional diver)
- {潜水|せんすい}{服|ふく} (diving suit)
- ⟦スキューバ→スキューバ：23452_sukyuuba⟧{潜水|せんすい} (scuba diving)
- {潜水|せんすい}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (dive time / submersion time)

For recreational scuba diving, ⟦ダイビング→ダイビング：05238_daibingu⟧ is more commonly used in casual speech. {潜水|せんすい} has a more formal or technical tone and is standard in military and professional contexts.
